description: This file defines types, interfaces, enums, and constants related to SQL editing and query management in the Superset frontend, including QueryEditor, Table, and application state types.

classes.name: QueryEditor
classes.description: Represents a SQL query editor instance with properties like id, sql, schema, and cursor position.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a database table with metadata and state flags.

classes.name: QueryCostEstimate
classes.description: Holds estimated cost and status information for a query.

methods.name: QueryEditorVersion
methods.description: Enum for different versions of the query editor.

methods.name: LatestQueryEditorVersion
methods.description: Constant representing the latest version of the query editor.
